enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing. Turning to left side. Adjusting pillow. Pulling blanket up. Turning to right side. Adjusting pillow. Breathing. Turning to back. Adjusting blanket. Stretching legs. Yawning. Adjusting pillow again.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with the kettle and toaster, having tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour hot water into mug. Take toast out of toaster. Put toast on plate. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Stand up. Pick up plate. Put plate in sink. Pick up mug. Put mug in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed for work and packing bag with laptop and notebook
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out laptop. Place laptop in bag. Take notebook from desk. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter office building. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and replying to emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email client. Read email. Type reply. Send reply. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Write notes. Open program schedule. Update schedule. Talk to colleague. Send email. Read email. Reply to email.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to café. Enter café. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Get up. Leave café. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work at the office, meeting community partners and updating program schedules
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open document. Update schedule. Meet with partner. Shake hands. Discuss program. Take notes. Return to desk. Send email. Make phone call. Update calendar. Write report. Talk to colleague. Send email. Read email. Reply to email.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Put plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. TV turns on. Browse channels. Select program. Watch TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Put remote down. Stretch. Yawn. Pick up remote. Change channel. Adjust volume. Put remote down. Get up. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and wiping kitchen surfaces
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Place plates in dishwasher. Pick up glasses. Place in dishwasher. Pick up utensils. Place in dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start. Pick up cloth. Wet cloth. Wipe table. Wipe counter. Rinse cloth. Wring cloth. Hang cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer at the desk lamp for personal admin and planning next day's program activities
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Log in. Open browser. Check bank account. Pay bills. Open calendar. Plan next day. Write notes. Close laptop. Turn off lamp. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Apply soap. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Change into pajamas. Lie down.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping for the night with the fan on low
enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing. Turning to left side. Adjusting pillow. Pulling blanket up. Turning to right side. Adjusting pillow. Breathing. Turning to back. Adjusting blanket. Stretching legs. Yawning. Adjusting pillow again.
